evidence: Ingested training_data.csv into Hopsworks feature group leak_train_1 and analyzed it on-platform via Trino SQL. Pearson correlation with label: f1=0.017, f2=0.992, f3=0.086, f4=0.066, f5=0.119, f6=0.084 — f2 is an extreme outlier. Class-conditional stats confirm perfect separation with NO overlap: for label=0, f2 ranges [-0.464, 0.436] (mean ~0.00); for label=1, f2 ranges [2.041, 3.014] (mean ~2.48). A single threshold near 1.0 classifies all 800 rows correctly, which is impossible for a legitimate pre-outcome feature. f2 leaks the outcome (computed from post-outcome data).
